values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground on the west side of Burt Lake, 4 mi E of Brutus via East Brutus Road and Maple Bay Road (Cheboygan County, per the DNR amenity table); managed by Burt Lake State Park. A grassy day-use area lies between the campground and a narrow sandy shoreline; two-lane boat launch. Panfish, bass, pike, walleye, muskie, perch and trout in Burt Lake. --Claude
